behavior.Google: Existing server verified linked identity and fresh auth_time remain authoritative. GIS initialize auto_select:false, nonce, essential_claims auth_time/amr; finite per-render state binds frozen intent. Field edits, Escape/cancel, boundary and pagehide discard attempts. No real provider or JWK/OAuth acceptance claimed.
behavior.email: Explicit empty-body request under the same browser WebLock, CSRF meta and browser marker. Provider acceptance is not delivery. ACK/503 require manual status query before another operation; no automatic retry/refresh/readback.
behavior.initial_status: GET-only own Bearer status plus existing factor status, exact captured access and context verification. Invalid or unavailable status stays unknown, never defaults to eligible contact confirmation.
behavior.password: Capture and validate primary intent, new password, confirmation and selected factor in RAM before await; clear input DOM immediately. Existing primary password or linked Google reauthentication; current factor when active. No added ordinary step-up.
behavior.revoking: Same metodobase.browser-session.v1 lock through full response/Set-Cookie/JSON. Valid success or uncertainty after dispatch clears local access and publishes epoch BEFORE unlocking. Confirmed403/409/422/429 rejection does not fabricate revocation. No new pair, automatic refresh, retry or old-identity readback.
behavior.secrets: Password, primary proof, selected factor and provider attempt only in RAM. No Storage, URL, analytics or logs; references and typed inputs cleared at dispatch, cancel, session boundary and pagehide. JavaScript strings are not claimed to be cryptographically erased from the engine.
behavior.terminal: Opaque WeakMap-backed terminal result permits only a same-epoch checked public success/uncertainty notice after session-shell clears the private main. External boundary/pagehide suppresses late ACK/provider callbacks.
